title: Recover the Archive

beats.narrativeText: With the Signal Tower's long-range communications finally restored, the learner unlocks something the whole campaign has been building toward: the expedition's protected archive.
Inside is Dr. Elara Quinn's final report — the one document that can finally explain why the expedition really stopped, after eighteen missions of clues, corrupted logs and careful guesswork.
The learner reads the final report slowly and carefully, aware that this is the last piece of the puzzle.
Comparing the original evidence against everything the learner has discovered themselves starts to confirm the whole story, piece by piece.
The learner must complete the missing sections of the archive using their own discoveries — the expedition's record, finished in their words, not just Dr. Quinn's.

The completed archive finally answers it: the expedition didn't vanish, and they didn't fail. They suspended their own work because their discoveries needed careful verification before anyone risked publishing them.
The learner reflects on why the expedition chose to preserve their evidence and wait, rather than risk publishing conclusions that might have been wrong.
The expedition mystery is resolved. Dr. Quinn's intentions are fully understood, the archive is restored — and the whole story of Outpost Echo finally has an ending.

activities.title: Read Final Report
activities.storyContext: The expedition's protected archive has been unlocked, and inside it is Dr. Elara Quinn's final report — her own account, at last.
activities.instructions: Read Dr. Quinn's final report carefully, from beginning to end, before drawing any conclusions.
activities.output: Notes on what the final report reveals.

activities.title: Compare Original and Current Evidence
activities.storyContext: The learner's own discoveries can finally be compared directly against the expedition's original evidence, mission by mission.
activities.instructions: Compare the original expedition evidence with what you have discovered throughout the campaign, and note where they confirm each other.
activities.output: Notes comparing original and current evidence.

activities.title: Complete Missing Archive Sections
activities.storyContext: The archive is almost complete, but a few sections only exist now because of what the learner discovered, not what Dr. Quinn recorded.
activities.instructions: Complete the missing sections of the archive using your own discoveries from across the whole campaign.

activities.title: Summarise Findings
activities.storyContext: The archive now brings together everything the learner has uncovered about Outpost Echo, from Mission 1 onward.
activities.instructions: Summarise the expedition mystery and what it reveals about Dr. Quinn's intentions, as if explaining it to someone who's never heard the story.
activities.output: A summary of the expedition mystery.

activities.title: Write a Letter to Future Explorers
activities.storyContext: Dr. Quinn preserved evidence for future Explorers to continue the investigation.
activities.instructions: Write a letter to future Explorers explaining the importance of careful investigation.

activities.title: Discoveries That Took Years to Verify
activities.storyContext: The expedition wasn't the only group of scientists to wait before publishing a discovery.
activities.instructions: Research a historical scientific discovery that required years of verification before acceptance.
activities.output: None required — this is an open investigation.

prompts: Why do you think the expedition chose to preserve their evidence rather than risk being wrong, and would you have made the same choice?

discussionPoints: Why do you think the expedition waited to publish their discoveries?
What was the most surprising thing you learned from the final report?
parentGuide.assessment: Look for a summary that captures the key findings and a completed archive that reflects the learner's own discoveries.

completionCriteria: Final report read, evidence compared, missing archive sections completed, and findings summarised.
